C 23 H 26 N 2 O 4 . Clinical. ─ Headache. Paralysis. Characteristics. ─ Lepelletier has recorded the following effects of 0.02 to 0.90 of a gramme of Brucinum . Sudden jerking, especially of lower extremities, spreading generally but not accompanied by trismus and tetanus, and not extending to sophagus and pharynx as with Strychnia . Twitching in the paralysed as well as healthy muscles. A fever of short duration ends the attacks; after which deep sleep comes on. Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main
